questions.text: Describe a house or apartment you would like to live in.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a house or apartment you would like to live in. You should say: where it would be; what it would look like; who you would live there with; and explain why you would like to live there.

questions.text: Do you think you will be able to live in a home like this one day?
questions.say: Thank you. Do you think you will be able to live in a home like this one day?

questions.text: What makes a home comfortable to live in?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a house or apartment you would like to live in, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all homes and design. What makes a home comfortable to live in?
